title: Phishing SMS received
description: Got a suspicious OTP text from an unknown number asking for bank details and credit card information. The message claimed to be from a major bank.

title: Suspicious person near apartments
description: A person was seen checking car doors in the apartment parking lot at 2am. They fled when approached by security.

title: Ugh traffic is so bad today
description: Can't believe how terrible the traffic is today. Why does everyone drive so badly? So frustrated with this city.

title: Suspicious person near apartments again
description: Saw someone trying car door handles in the parking area late at night. Very concerning behaviour.

title: Someone checking cars in parking
description: A suspicious individual was spotted checking multiple car doors in the apartment complex parking lot around midnight.

title: Fake bank SMS
description: Received an SMS pretending to be from my bank asking me to verify my account by sharing OTP and card details immediately.

title: Phishing message received
description: Got a text message asking for my bank OTP and credit card details. The number looked suspicious and unofficial.

title: Street harassment near metro
description: A woman reported being followed by an unknown man near a metro exit late in the evening. She managed to reach a crowded area safely.

title: Laptop stolen from cafe
description: A laptop was stolen from a popular cafe on 5th Block. The owner stepped away briefly and returned to find it missing. CCTV footage requested.

title: Waterlogging after heavy rain
description: The road near the BDA complex is completely waterlogged after last night's rain. Knee-deep water, several vehicles stalled.

title: Fake delivery scam
description: Residents received calls from someone claiming to be a delivery agent asking for an OTP to release a package. No package was expected. Likely a scam.

title: Gas leak reported in apartment
description: Strong smell of gas reported on the 3rd floor of an apartment building on 7th Main. Residents evacuated the floor. Gas agency contacted.

title: This place is honestly terrible
description: So annoyed with how dirty and loud this neighbourhood is. Nobody cares about anyone else here. Worst decision moving here.

title: Thunderstorm warning for evening
description: Local weather department has issued a thunderstorm warning for the city and surrounding areas. Heavy rain and lightning expected between 6pm and 10pm.

title: Power outage affecting 3rd and 4th block
description: Power has been out since 8pm in 3rd and 4th block. The distribution company has been notified but no ETA given. Residents advised to use backup lighting.

title: Bike theft near supermarket
description: A motorcycle was stolen from outside a supermarket on 1st Main in broad daylight. Owner has filed a complaint. CCTV footage being reviewed.

title: Fraud call impersonating police
description: Received a call from someone claiming to be a police officer demanding immediate payment to avoid arrest. Classic fraud attempt targeting elderly residents.

title: Heavy rainfall and waterlogging
description: Severe waterlogging reported near an underpass. Water level is knee deep and vehicles are getting stuck. Avoid the area if possible.

title: Bike theft reported
description: A motorcycle was stolen from outside a supermarket in broad daylight. CCTV footage is being reviewed. Residents advised to use locks.

title: Why is everyone so rude here
description: So annoying how people just cut queues at the grocery store. Unbelievable behaviour. This city has no civic sense whatsoever.

title: ATM card skimming device found
description: A skimming device was discovered on an ATM. Customers who used it in the last 48 hours are advised to check their bank statements.

title: Stray dog attack near park
description: A resident was bitten by a stray dog near a park early in the morning. The person has been taken to a nearby clinic for anti-rabies treatment.

title: Ransomware attack on local business
description: A small business owner reported their office computers were infected with ransomware. Attackers demanded payment in cryptocurrency. Police complaint filed.

title: Flash flood warning issued
description: Flash flood advisory issued for low-lying areas following heavy rainfall upstream. Residents near stormwater drains advised to stay alert.

title: Chain snatching near sector 7
description: Two men on a bike snatched a gold chain from a woman walking near Sector 7 in the evening. A police complaint has been filed and the case is under investigation.

title: Broken street light on 27th main
description: The street light on 27th Main near the bus stop has been non-functional for over a week. The area is completely dark at night and unsafe for pedestrians.

title: Ugh the roads here are disgusting
description: Can't believe the state of the roads during monsoon. Every season it's the same thing. Nobody fixes anything. So frustrated.

title: Suspicious van parked for 3 days
description: An unmarked white van has been parked outside a residential building for 3 days. No one has seen the driver. Residents feel uneasy.

title: Identity theft complaint filed
description: A resident discovered that someone had opened a credit card in their name using stolen documents. The case has been reported to cybercrime cell.

title: Electrical sparking on main road
description: Electrical sparking observed from a transformer on the main road near the water tank. Distribution company notified. Residents advised to keep distance.

title: Suspicious email from bank
description: Received an email asking to verify account details by clicking a link. The sender domain looked fake. Possible phishing attempt targeting bank customers.

title: Gas leak smell near residential area
description: Strong smell of gas reported near a residential complex on the main road. Residents have been asked to stay away from the area until authorities arrive.

title: Thunderstorm warning issued
description: Local weather authorities have issued a thunderstorm warning for the city and nearby areas. Heavy rain, lightning and strong winds expected. Stay indoors if possible.

title: ATM skimming device found near ITPL
description: A skimming device was discovered on an ATM. Customers who used the ATM in the last 48 hours are advised to check their statements immediately.

title: Laptop bag snatched near tech park
description: An employee leaving a tech park had their laptop bag snatched by a man on a motorcycle. Police complaint registered and CCTV footage requested.

title: Vishing call targeting IT employees
description: Multiple residents received calls from someone claiming to be from their company's IT department asking for VPN credentials and system passwords. Do not share credentials over phone.

title: Flooding near lake area
description: Heavy flooding reported near a local lake following continuous rainfall. Roads submerged, several cars stranded. Avoid the flooded stretch entirely.

title: This city is just hopeless honestly
description: Every single day something goes wrong here. The infrastructure, the traffic, the noise. I just can't with this place anymore.

title: Data breach at popular food app
description: A food delivery app confirmed a data breach exposing names, addresses and payment details. Users advised to change passwords immediately.

title: Suspicious persons near school gate
description: Two unknown men were seen loitering near a school gate during dismissal time. School security alerted. Parents advised to be present during pickup hours.

title: Online job scam targeting freshers
description: Multiple reports of a fake job portal targeting fresh graduates. Victims paid registration fees and never heard back. Cybercrime complaint filed.

title: Tree fell on road after storm
description: A large tree fell across the main road following last night's storm. Road partially blocked. City crew deployed.

title: Drunk driver hit two parked cars
description: A drunk driver hit two parked cars on the service road at midnight. Police arrived and the driver was detained. Owners should check for damage.

title: UPI fraud targeting senior citizens
description: Several elderly residents reported being tricked into sending money via UPI by callers claiming to offer government pension benefits. Do not share UPI pins with anyone.

title: Broken water main flooding street
description: A water main burst on the service road near the old market area. The street has been flooded since morning. City notified but repairs yet to begin.

title: Fire in commercial building
description: A fire broke out on the second floor of a commercial building. Fire department responded within 15 minutes. No casualties reported. Building evacuated.

title: Heatwave advisory issued
description: IMD has issued a heatwave advisory for the city and eastern areas. Temperatures expected to cross 40 degrees. Elderly and children advised to stay indoors between 11am and 4pm.

title: Wallet stolen at crowded market
description: A resident reported their wallet being pickpocketed at the crowded weekend market. Be vigilant with valuables in crowded areas.

title: Fake electricity bill scam
description: Residents received WhatsApp messages with fake electricity bills containing a malicious payment link. Do not click. Pay only through official apps or websites.

title: Road cave-in near signal
description: A section of road near a signal caved in overnight, creating a large pothole. Two-wheeler riders at risk. City has been informed but no barricades placed yet.
